description: A reading list as a starting point: BibTeX, RIS (Zotero, EndNote), a CSV export, or lines of DOIs, urls and titles. Every entry with a locator is fetched onto the shelves as a collection; one that cannot be read becomes a source request; an entry with a title only is listed so the person can give it a locator or research it by name (library_items). watch=true has the housekeeping re-read the pages. Then library_research with sources=shelves and the collection reads from them. Paths from the keeper only.

collection.description: The collection the entries are shelved in (default: from the title).

limit.description: How many entries to take (default all, up to 200).

path.description: The list on this machine (absolute path).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

title.description: A name for the list (default: the file name).

watch.description: Re-read the pages nightly and keep a new copy when one changes.

name: library_reading
